name: Component Specification
purpose: Specify component props, variants, keyboard accessibility, and state contracts.
inputs: Component responsibility, usage contexts, and explicit non-goals
Typed props, variants, sizes, states, tokens, and responsive constraints
Keyboard, focus, screen-reader, and test-fixture acceptance criteria
outputs: Implementation-ready component API and complete state matrix
Controlled-state, slot, event, and focus contracts
Keyboard and ARIA fixtures plus an unresolved-exception register
stop_conditions: Every prop, state cell, event, and keyboard path is resolved or justified
State fixtures cover default, loading, empty, error, and disabled behavior
Token budget exhausted or component ownership is disputed
